case: domain-over-enum array app parser and keyed grid edit preserve the element domain
contract: The app parser preserves a domain-over-enum array edit as exact text and the keyed-update builder casts to the qualified element domain array.
A live edit preserves literal NULL, empty text, Unicode and SQL NULL elements against native type, JSON and array_send byte oracles.
An invalid enum value violates the element domain CHECK with SQLSTATE 23514; the transaction leaves the prior row unchanged.

domain_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

app_parser_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib value_contract_postgres_domain_enum_array_grid_literal_stays_text_with_domain_cast -- --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-driver-postgres -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings
